record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: shop-phase item-drop passive (OnItemDroppedEffect; no combat effect)
record.summary: Passive.RECYCLE is an OnItemDroppedEffect registered in PassiveEffects (passives.ts:1506): it acts when the player drags a consumable from the inventory onto a TRUBBISH (1 star) or GARBODOR (2 stars) (POISON + ARTIFICIAL, maxPP 100, range 1, skill GUNK_SHOT), not during a fight. A berry is eaten: the board unit's base max HP and HP rise by +15 (+45 for NANAB, GOLDEN_RAZZ, GOLDEN_NANAB, GOLDEN_PINAP), via Pokemon.addMaxHP (hp = max(1, hp + amount), maxHP = hp); the berry is removed from player.items (first occurrence) and is not equipped. Any other item in ConsumableItems (TMs, Dishes, Mulches, Flavors, Sweets, Dojo tickets, exchange / recycle ticket, picnic set, fire shard, cell battery, the scrolls, auspicious / malicious armor, soothe bell) gives +30 max HP and is likewise removed and not equipped; unless it is a Dish, Flavor or Sweet, a TRASH item is added to player.items, and for a TM the first matching entry of player.tms is replaced by TRASH. Non-consumable items return true and are equipped by the normal flow. The item's own OnItemDroppedEffects also run (no short-circuit), and any false result vetoes equipping. These are the requested amounts: addMaxHP has no AP, star or item scaling and no cap in the code read (the unit's stored hp and maxHP are raised permanently on the board object); nothing is a fight stat helper, so Big Eater Belt / Twist Band / Protect / Rune Protect do not take part. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: OnDragDropItemCommand.execute: player drags an item the player holds onto a board/bench pokemon whose passive is RECYCLE; all OnItemDroppedEffects of the item and of the passive are applied

effects.declaredRaw: +15 max HP (berries), +45 for the four special berries
effects.scaling: none; fixed constants; no AP, level or star scaling
effects.resolution: requested = applied: pokemon.addMaxHP(amount) on the board Pokemon sets hp = max(1, hp + amount) and maxHP = hp; no cap or helper was found. The berry is taken out of player.items and the item is not equipped (effect returns false so the command is cancelled with DRAG_DROP_CANCEL).

effects.declaredRaw: +30 max HP for any other ConsumableItems entry
effects.resolution: requested = applied via Pokemon.addMaxHP(30); the item is removed from player.items; not equipped (returns false).

effects.declaredRaw: TRASH item for consumables other than Dishes, Flavors and Sweets (not for berries)
effects.resolution: Item.TRASH is pushed onto player.items; for a TM the first matching entry in player.tms (indexOf(item)) is replaced by TRASH via splice(indexOf, 1, TRASH); then the dropped consumable is removed from player.items. Berries return before this branch and never produce TRASH.

conditions: Only reached through OnDragDropItemCommand with a pokemon found at the drop position (or flower pot); the item must be in player.items and the player alive.
Berries are tested before the general consumable list; Berries are also part of ConsumableItems, so the berry branch wins.
Items not in Berries or ConsumableItems (components, craftable items, TRASH) return true: the passive does nothing and the normal equip flow continues.

Because all OnItemDroppedEffects run, the dropped item's own effect (for example a dojo ticket or an item with its own drop effect) also executes even when RECYCLE vetoes equipping; what those effects do was not traced here.
The check happens before the Dishes / holdability checks, so consumables such as Dishes are eaten by RECYCLE instead of reaching the canEat / dishes logic.
record.resetBehaviour: Not a fight effect: the HP bonus is written to the board Pokemon's hp and maxHP and so persists with the unit for the game (evolution / merging behaviour of these stats was not traced); no timer or counter exists.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: How the raised board hp / maxHP carries into fight entities (assumed to be read from the board Pokemon when the entity is created; not traced here)
What happens to the stored hp / maxHP when TRUBBISH evolves into GARBODOR or is merged (evolution code not read)
unresolved: The queue record has no routing uncertainty; the registry entry is PassiveEffects[Passive.RECYCLE] at passives.ts:1506, no other Passive.RECYCLE reference was found by grep except the two unit classes and the enum.

TM branch: player.tms.indexOf(item) is not guarded; if the item is not in player.tms (indexOf -1) splice(-1, 1, TRASH) would replace the LAST entry; whether a TM in the inventory can be absent from player.tms was not traced.
What a replaced TRASH entry in player.tms means for updateTms (it would later be given as an inventory item instead of a TM) was read only from the slice code; not traced further.
Effects of other OnItemDroppedEffects on the same drop (item side) were not enumerated.
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks.

evidence.note: TRUBBISH: 1 star, POISON + ARTIFICIAL, maxPP 100, range 1, skill GUNK_SHOT
GARBODOR: 2 stars, POISON + ARTIFICIAL, maxPP 100, range 1, skill GUNK_SHOT

one OnItemDroppedEffect: berries give +15 max HP (+45 for the four special berries), other consumables +30; both remove the item from player.items and return false (item not equipped); other items return true

for consumables that are not Dishes, Flavors or Sweets a TRASH item is pushed; if the item is a TM the matching entry of player.tms is replaced by TRASH; then the dropped item is removed from player.items

evidence.expect: return false to prevent equipping the item
evidence.note: OnItemDroppedEffect: called when an item is dragged to a pokemon; returning false prevents equipping

on a drag-drop of an inventory item onto a pokemon, the effects of the item AND of the pokemon passive that are OnItemDroppedEffect are all applied (no short-circuit); any false result cancels equipping
when equipping is vetoed the command sends DRAG_DROP_CANCEL and returns before the Dishes / holdability checks
the item must be in player.items; flower-pot zone and berry-tree zone have their own branches, other zones resolve the pokemon with player.getPokemonAt(x, y); a missing pokemon cancels
SpecialBerries = NANAB, GOLDEN_RAZZ, GOLDEN_NANAB, GOLDEN_PINAP; Berries = NonSpecialBerries + SpecialBerries

ConsumableItems = TMs, Dishes, Mulches, Flavors, Sweets, DojoTickets, Berries, plus EXCHANGE_TICKET, RECYCLE_TICKET, PICNIC_SET, FIRE_SHARD, CELL_BATTERY, the two scrolls, AUSPICIOUS_ARMOR, MALICIOUS_ARMOR, SOOTHE_BELL; TRASH is not in it
on the board Pokemon (not a fight entity): hp = max(1, hp + amount) then maxHP = hp; it changes the stored unit stats
player.tms is the ordered list of TMs of the player, indexed by Human synergy tier in updateTms
TMs are handed out from player.tms by position when the Human synergy tier grows; a TRASH written into player.tms would be given as an item instead
